All-on-X Solutions

The System Behind Predictable All-on-X Outcomes

A fully integrated full-arch workflow combining digital precision, prosthetically-driven planning, guided surgery, provisional restorations, and final restorations—all designed for the best prognosis.

01

MagnetiX™ Guided Surgery

Our patented stackable guided surgery system enabling seamless guided surgery and restoration

  • Full-Arch

Photogrammetry

Designed for immediate loading, tissue support, and transition to final restorations.

  • Full-Arch

Final Restoration

Connected Workflow for Predictable Results.

Full-arch implant dentistry involves multiple critical phases, each influencing the success of the next. Rather than treating these as separate services, 3DDX integrates them into a unified workflow designed for better coordination, accuracy, and long-term outcomes.
